offer_assumption_value_check.name: offer_assumption_value_check
offer_assumption_value_check.value: "app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."revision">0 AND ("app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."packaging_idr" IS NULL OR "app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."packaging_idr">=0) AND ("app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."provider_fee_idr" IS NULL OR "app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."provider_fee_idr">=0) AND ("app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."subsidy_idr" IS NULL OR "app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."subsidy_idr">=0) AND ("app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."returns_reserve_idr" IS NULL OR "app"."offer_cost_assumption_version"."returns_reserve_idr">=0)

outbox_lease_check.name: outbox_lease_check
outbox_lease_check.value: ("app"."outbox_job"."status" = 'processing' AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_until" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."outbox_job"."status" <> 'processing' AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_token" IS NULL AND "app"."outbox_job"."lease_until" IS NULL)

policy_scope_check.name: policy_scope_check
policy_scope_check.value: ("app"."policy_head"."kind" = 'commercial' AND "app"."policy_head"."warehouse_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."policy_head"."kind" = 'warehouse_calendar' AND "app"."policy_head"."warehouse_id" IS NOT NULL)

publication_offer_amount_check.name: publication_offer_amount_check
publication_offer_amount_check.value: ("app"."publication_offer"."estimated_hpp" IS NULL OR "app"."publication_offer"."estimated_hpp" between 0 and 9007199254740991) AND ("app"."publication_offer"."estimated_contribution" IS NULL OR "app"."publication_offer"."estimated_contribution" between -9007199254740991 and 99000)

publication_offer_complete_check.name: publication_offer_complete_check
publication_offer_complete_check.value: ("app"."publication_offer"."complete" AND "app"."publication_offer"."estimated_hpp" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."publication_offer"."estimated_contribution" IS NOT NULL) OR (NOT "app"."publication_offer"."complete" AND "app"."publication_offer"."estimated_contribution" IS NULL)

publication_version_value_check.name: publication_version_value_check
publication_version_value_check.value: "app"."publication_version"."revision">0 AND "app"."publication_version"."product_revision">0 AND "app"."publication_version"."minimum_contribution_idr" between 0 and 99000 AND "app"."publication_version"."commission_bps" between 0 and 10000

publication_reason_check.name: publication_reason_check
publication_reason_check.value: char_length("app"."publication_version"."reason") between 1 and 500 AND ("app"."publication_version"."exception_reason" IS NULL OR char_length("app"."publication_version"."exception_reason") between 1 and 500)

stock_movement_delta_check.name: stock_movement_delta_check
stock_movement_delta_check.value:
("app"."stock_movement"."kind" IN ('receive','transfer_in') AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"="app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta" between 0 and "app"."stock_movement"."quantity") OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='adjust_up' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"="app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=0) OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='adjust_down' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=0) OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='quarantine' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"="app"."stock_movement"."quantity") OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='release_quarantine' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity") OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='write_off' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity") OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='reserve' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"="app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=0) OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind"='release' AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=0 AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=0) OR
    ("app"."stock_movement"."kind" IN ('consume','transfer_out') AND "app"."stock_movement"."on_hand_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."reserved_delta"=-"app"."stock_movement"."quantity" AND "app"."stock_movement"."quarantined_delta"=0)

stock_reservation_kind_check.name: stock_reservation_kind_check
stock_reservation_kind_check.value: ("app"."stock_reservation"."kind"='checkout' AND "app"."stock_reservation"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_reservation"."expires_at">"app"."stock_reservation"."created_at") OR ("app"."stock_reservation"."kind"='transfer' AND "app"."stock_reservation"."expires_at" IS NULL)

stock_reservation_resolution_check.name: stock_reservation_resolution_check
stock_reservation_resolution_check.value: ("app"."stock_reservation"."status" IN ('preparing','active') AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolution_reason" IS NULL) OR ("app"."stock_reservation"."status" IN ('released','expired','consumed') AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."stock_reservation"."resolution_reason" IS NOT NULL AND char_length("app"."stock_reservation"."resolution_reason") between 1 and 500)

warehouse_transfer_state_check.name: warehouse_transfer_state_check
warehouse_transfer_state_check.value: ("app"."warehouse_transfer"."status" IN ('requested','cancelled') AND "app"."warehouse_transfer"."received_quantity"=0) OR "app"."warehouse_transfer"."status" IN ('dispatched','exception') OR ("app"."warehouse_transfer"."status"='received' AND "app"."warehouse_transfer"."received_quantity"="app"."warehouse_transfer"."quantity")
